item.title: Kagetsu Tooya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TYPE-MOON
  • 発売日: 2001-08-13
  • スコア: 7.340000000000001/10 (3498 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 歌月十夜
  • 英語名: Kagetsu Tooya

あらすじ

One year after the events of Tsukihime, Shiki Tohno is a victim of an accident. After this accident, Shiki awakens into a strange dream wherein he repeats the same day over and over. There are infinitely many endings to the day, but it always begins anew after each day. Eventually, Shiki discovers that he must find Len, the creator of the dream, if he wishes to escape.

item.title: Tsukihime
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TYPE-MOON
  • 発売日: 1999-08
  • スコア: 8.18/10 (11443 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 月姫
  • 英語名: Tsukihime

别名

  • Tsukihime‛： Blue Blue Glass Moon

あらすじ

This story is about a young boy named Toono Shiki who, after experiencing a traumatic accident, wakes up in the hospital with the ability to see lines and cracks in every surface and being. These lines, when traced with any sharp or blunt edge, will be permanently cut. As he is forced to see these lines everywhere, Shiki is distraught until he meets a mage girl who gives him glasses that allow him to live a normal life.
